question_set.question: Use find_extremes with top_n equal to 5, mode equal to both and use add_marginal_bars with show_top equal to True, show_right equal to True in order to know How do smoking status and alcohol consumption affect vitamin C intake?

answer.value: Former smokers and those who never smoke show interesting vitamin C patterns. Former smokers with moderate alcohol consumption have the highest vitamin C intake (90.9%), while never smokers with moderate alcohol consumption have the lowest (85.3%). Heavy alcohol drinkers maintain relatively high vitamin C levels across all smoking categories, especially among never smokers (90.8%). No alcohol consumption is consistently moderate to high, peaking at 90.3% among former smokers.

key_insights: Former smokers with moderate alcohol have highest vitamin C (90.9%)
Never smokers with moderate alcohol have lowest vitamin C (85.3%)
Heavy drinkers maintain high vitamin C across smoking categories
No alcohol consumption is consistently moderate to high
